title: Canonical scalar map into a completed local ring
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a morphism, where $\operatorname{Spec}$ is the affine spectrum [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $x\in X$. Write $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $\mathfrak m_x$ for its maximal ideal. The canonical completed-local scalar map $k\to\widehat R$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] is the composite $k\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}k,\mathcal O)\xrightarrow{f^\#}\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)\xrightarrow{\mathrm{germ}_x}R\to\widehat R$, where the last map is maximal-ideal completion. Its associated $k$-algebra structure on $\widehat R$ is the one used for completed local $k$-algebras; no coefficient field or splitting is chosen.
